# Official SkillEngine source

Unmodified SKILL.md, assets and references copied from https://github.com/PharosNetwork/pharos-skill-engine at commit a873387c9e34e9ae8e71360d43dc33329a335a24 on 2026-11-02. The official https://www.pharos.xyz/agent-center page identifies the package as MIT-0 (free to use, modify and redistribute). Upstream files retain original content and naming. No private keys are included.

The application logo assets/pharos-logo.jpg is an exact byte copy of the user's supplied pharos_logo.jpg.jpg, with no pixel modifications. CSS crops only its surrounding white canvas for display. UI primary blue #0306B5 was sampled from the supplied logo. Pharos marks retain their owners' rights.
